title: Profile of a person
justification: one entity_history(uid, include_edges) carries every returned scalar in the version's props and creationDate as vt_s; compute filter(rel_type eq IS_LOCATED_IN) over the incident edges yields the City uid, which is `cityId` under the mapping

title: Recent messages of a person
justification: the ten most recent messages are reachable (incident HAS_CREATOR edges, then topk on vt_s), but each one then needs a variable-length typed REPLY_OF walk to its root Post and the root author's names — a per-row expansion with no iteration primitive in the plan language

title: Friends of a person
justification: friend uids and friendship dates come from one entity_history+filter chain; firstName/lastName per friend do not — operators take one uid, no operator projects props for a set of nodes, and the plan DAG has no map

title: Content of a message
justification: one call on the Message uid: creationDate is the version's vt_s and content/imageFile are its props

title: Creator of a message
justification: the incident HAS_CREATOR edge gives the creator uid; a $ref binds that scalar into a second entity_history whose props carry firstName and lastName

title: Forum of a message
justification: variable-length typed REPLY_OF walk to the root Post, then CONTAINER_OF and HAS_MODERATOR, then the moderator's names

title: Replies of a message
justification: two-hop typed pattern to each reply's author, per-author name projection, and an optional KNOWS test whose *absence* is part of the answer

title: Transitive friends with a certain name
justification: ranks friends by shortest-path distance 1..3 (a hop count, which no operator returns), selects on firstName equality, and projects thirteen attributes plus nested university and company tuples

title: Recent messages by your friends
justification: one-hop KNOWS then HAS_CREATOR into messages under a date bound is a typed two-way pattern; the answer projects message content and each author's names

title: Friends and friends of friends in countries X and Y
justification_15: the two per-country counts are summed per friend once the sets are joined — a derived column, not a scalar quotient
justification_17: the two per-friend counts must be summed, so the sets have to be aligned on the friend and carry their values
justification: two country restrictions reached through Message->Country, an intersection of the two per-friend count sets, their sum, and a not-located-in exclusion

title: New topics
justification: tags of friends' posts inside a window minus tags used before it — a typed three-hop pattern with a set difference over grouped counts

title: New groups
justification: forums joined after a date by friends and friends-of-friends, counted by that same friend's posts inside each forum: a three-way typed join underneath a grouping

title: Tag co-occurrence
justification: co-occurring tags on friends' posts carrying a given tag; tag identity is reached through HAS_TAG and the anchor tag is excluded from its own histogram

title: Recent likers
justification_15: latency in minutes is (like time - message creation) per row, then a divide — a derived column, not a scalar quotient
justification: most recent like per liker, latency in minutes from the message's creation (a division), and an is-new test against the KNOWS set

title: Recent replies
justification: replies to any message of a person — a typed three-hop pattern — projecting reply content and author names

title: Recent messages by friends or friends of friends
justification: two-hop KNOWS expansion into messages under a date bound, projecting content and author names

title: Friend recommendation
justification_15: the common-minus-non-common score is per candidate friend
justification: exactly-two-hop friends filtered by a birthday month/day window, scored as common-interest minus non-common counts

title: Job referral
justification: friends and friends-of-friends with a WORK_AT edge into a named country before a year; the year predicate is on an integer attribute and the company->country restriction is a typed two-hop pattern

title: Expert search
justification: comments replying to posts whose tags sit under a TagClass, requiring a variable-length IS_SUBCLASS_OF walk and a per-friend distinct count

title: Single shortest path
justification: unbounded shortest-path length over KNOWS. temporal_paths caps at six hops and ranks by (arrival, hops, edge sequence) rather than reporting the minimum hop count; temporal_reachability returns earliest arrival, not distance

title: Trusted connection paths
justification_15: the path weight is summed per path from interaction counts
justification: all shortest paths over KNOWS plus a weight summed from interaction counts. v2 replaces this with a Dijkstra cheapest path, which is no closer to any operator

title: Posting summary
justification_15: both remaining numbers are per bucket — the average message length within the group and that group's share of the global total — so a whole-input mean and a two-scalar percent reach neither
justification: three grouping dimensions (year x isComment x length bucket) against a cap of two, a calendar year rather than a fixed stride, an aggregate over message length (a JSON prop — explicitly deferred in D-044), an average, and a percentage of a global total

title: Tag evolution
justification_15: the two windows are differenced per tag, with abs()
justification_17: the two windows are joined per tag and differenced
justification: the nearest miss on the aggregation side: per-tag counts in one window ARE an aggregate_events grouping by dst endpoint. The two windows must then be joined per tag, differenced with abs(), restricted to a TagClass through HAS_TYPE, and reported by tag name

title: Popular topics in a country
justification: forums in a country whose threads carry a TagClass, counting messages over a variable-length reply chain

title: Top message creators
justification: top-100 forums by member count, then top message creators inside them, with a UNION ALL over two branches

title: Most active posters
justification_15: 1*m + 2*r + 10*l is a weighted sum per person
justification_17: message, reply and like counts joined per person
justification: per-poster message, reply and like counts joined per person and combined as 1*m + 2*r + 10*l

title: Most authoritative users
justification_17: per-message like counts joined into a per-author score
justification: two-level like propagation: per-message like counts feed a per-author authority score, a join between two groupings

title: Related topics
justification: tags carried by replies to messages carrying a tag, excluding that tag itself

title: Central person for a tag
justification_15: 100*i + m is a weighted sum per person
justification_17: two groupings joined per person, plus the friends' summed scores
justification: interest and message scores per person plus the summed scores of that person's friends — a join of two groupings and a weighted sum (100*i + m)

title: Top thread initiators
justification_15: AR was over-tagged here: counts and sums are original-13 aggregates, and what blocks the template is reaching message length (a prop) under a grouping over a variable-length walk
justification: per-thread message counts and length sums over variable-length reply chains inside a window

title: Experts in social circle
justification: a variable-length friend expansion at distance 3-4, a country restriction, a TagClass restriction and an explicit set difference

title: Friend triangles
justification: the nearest miss in the whole set. M_triangle_cyclic and M_triangle_acyclic_1 between them cover both orientation classes of a triangle, and the date window is a valid-time window. But the country restriction is a typed two-hop pattern (Person->City->Country), node_filter caps at 10,000 uids against 68,673 Persons at SF10, and the delta-motif contract counts *time-ordered* instances under a span bound rather than undirected triangles, so the two counts would have to be argued equal rather than read off

title: How many persons have a given number of messages
justification_15: AR was over-tagged here too: a histogram of persons by their message count is a grouping over a grouping, and the threshold is `filter(count ge k)`, which shipped with the original thirteen
justification: a histogram of persons by their qualifying-message count — a grouping over the result of a grouping — with a message length predicate on a prop

title: Zombies in a country
justification_15: the zombie rate is per person: messages over months since that person's own account creation
justification_17: the zombie set joined to its likers
justification: the zombie definition is a per-calendar-month message rate since account creation, and the reported ratio needs a join between the zombie set and its likers

title: International dialog
justification_15: the 4/1/10/1 score is per city-pair row
justification_17: four reply patterns combined per city pair
justification: per-city top interacting person pair across two countries, scored 4/1/10/1 over four distinct reply patterns

title: Weighted interaction paths
justification_15: 1/(interaction count + 1) is a derived edge weight
justification: a weighted shortest path where the weight is 1/(interaction count + 1) computed over a window — a Dijkstra over a derived projection

title: Fake news detection
justification_15: the two tag counts are summed per person
justification_17: two per-person tag counts joined and summed
justification: persons who posted about two different tags on two given calendar dates, joined per person and summed

title: Information propagation analysis
justification: an eight-step typed pattern with two variable-length reply chains and a duration offset between two message times

title: Friend recommendation
justification: mutual friends sharing a tag, excluding pairs that already know each other

title: Interaction path between cities
justification_15: a derived weighted projection, as BI15
justification: cheapest interaction path between persons in two cities over a derived weighted projection

title: Recruitment
justification_15: the weight is the difference of study years, per edge
justification: cheapest path weighted by the difference of study years — a Dijkstra over a projection built from STUDY_AT attributes
